summary: [FE][BE][MT] Verify Extend Daily Report adds days after the last execution day and does not change the Plan Ramp Down/Up Date, the snapshot or the event Planned Date, also after a second Extension and after deleting the extended days (POS/NEG)

steps.action: Freeze the last execution day of the Daily Report.
steps.result: The confirmation `Extend Daily Report` appears with `Confirm` and `Cancel`.

steps.action: Click `Cancel`.
steps.result: The confirmation closes and no day is added.

steps.action: Freeze the last execution day again and click `Confirm`.
steps.result: One or more execution days are added after the old last execution day.

steps.action: Read the last execution day.
steps.result: It is later than `22 Feb 2026`.

steps.action: Open `Edit Plan` of `Plan Scenario Ext` and read the dates.
steps.result: They are still `20 Feb 2026 18:00 - 22 Feb 2026 07:00`.

steps.action: Read the badge on the Plan Card.
steps.result: It shows `Ramp Down/Up Date: 20 Feb 2026 18:00 - 22 Feb 2026 07:00`.

steps.action: Open the Daily Report Gantt and look at the `Ramp Down` and `Ramp Up` lines.
steps.result: One `Ramp Down` line on the snapshot Ramp Down date and one `Ramp Up` line on `22 Feb 2026`; the added days are after the `Ramp Up` line.

steps.action: Look at the end of the Planned S-Curve.
steps.result: It ends on the new last execution day (snapshot Ramp Up plus the added days).

steps.action: Open Edit Shutdown Event and read the Planned Date.
Freeze the new last execution day and click `Confirm`.
steps.result: More days are added after the last one.

steps.action: Read the badge and the `Ramp Up` line again.
steps.result: The badge is unchanged and there is still exactly one `Ramp Up` line on `22 Feb 2026`.

steps.action: Delete the extended days.
steps.result: The extended days are removed.

steps.action: Read the badge, `Edit Plan` and the `Ramp Down` / `Ramp Up` lines.
steps.result: All are unchanged: `20 Feb 2026 18:00 - 22 Feb 2026 07:00`, one line each on the snapshot dates.

summary: [FE][MT] Verify the Excel export of Shutdown Logic, Manpower Mob Plan and Equipment Mob Plan shows Ramp Down Date and Ramp Up Date with the Plan values

steps.action: Open the Shutdown Logic, Manpower Mob Plan or Equipment Mob Plan page of `Plan Scenario A`.
steps.result: The page opens with the `Export` button.

steps.action: Click `Export` and choose Excel.
steps.result: An Excel file is downloaded.

steps.action: Open the file and look for the labels in the metadata part.
steps.result: The labels `Ramp Down Date` and `Ramp Up Date` are shown.

steps.action: Look for the old labels.
steps.result: The labels `Start Event Date` and `End Event Date` do not appear.

steps.action: Read the values next to the two labels.
steps.result: `Ramp Down Date` shows `15 Feb 2026` and `Ramp Up Date` shows `25 Feb 2026` (the Plan values), not the event Planned Date `08 Feb 2026`.

steps.action: For the Shutdown Logic file only, read the date of `Day1` (ETM-5492).
steps.result: `Day1` is `15 Feb 2026`.

summary: [FE][BE][MT] Verify the very long range `15 Feb 2026 08:00 - 15 Feb 2029 20:15` on the badge, in the Daily Report and in the Excel export, and the badge and a long Plan Name on a narrow card

steps.action: Create a Plan named `Plan Scenario Long Name Plan Scenario Long Name 12` (50 characters) with `15 Feb 2026 08:00 - 15 Feb 2029 20:15` and read the badge.
steps.result: The badge shows `Ramp Down/Up Date: 15 Feb 2026 08:00 - 15 Feb 2029 20:15`.

steps.action: Create the Shutdown Logic of that Plan.
steps.result: The Shutdown Logic row shows as created.

steps.action: Create the Daily Report for that Plan and open it.
steps.result: The Daily Report opens.

steps.action: Note down the first and the last day of the Gantt chart.
steps.result: The two days are written down and the Gantt shows no wrong date format.

steps.action: Open the Shutdown Logic of that Plan and export it to Excel.
steps.result: An Excel file is downloaded.

steps.action: Read `Ramp Down Date` and `Ramp Up Date` in the metadata.
steps.result: They show `15 Feb 2026` and `15 Feb 2029`.

steps.action: Set the browser window width to 600 px and look at the card header.
steps.result: The badge stays on one line with its full text.

steps.action: Read the Plan Name in the card header.
steps.result: The Plan Name is cut with an ellipsis (`…`).

steps.action: Hover over the Plan Name.
steps.result: The full name `Plan Scenario Long Name Plan Scenario Long Name 12` is shown.

summary: [FE][BE][MT] Verify a Daily Report created before the release still shows the dates of its event Planned Date after the release (BND)

steps.action: Open the old Daily Report.
steps.result: The Daily Report opens and the page works without an error.

steps.action: Read the First Execution Date.
steps.result: It is `16 Jun 2026` (event Planned start `10:00` is before `18:00`, so the day before).

steps.action: Read the last execution day.
steps.result: It is `15 Jul 2026` (event Planned end).

steps.action: Note down the first and the last day of the Gantt chart.
steps.result: The two days are written down and the Gantt shows no error.

steps.action: Look at the end of the Planned S-Curve.
steps.result: It ends on `15 Jul 2026`.

steps.action: Export the Daily Report to PDF and read the Day numbering.
steps.result: Day 1 is `16 Jun 2026`.

steps.action: Reload the old Daily Report and read the First Execution Date and the last execution day.
steps.result: They are still `16 Jun 2026` and `15 Jul 2026`.
